result.topic_en: Notes on an infinite product of theta-function type in q with factors involving $\varrho_2 e^{\psi\sqrt{-1}}$, the observation that its numerator and denominator are conjugate so the quotient has modulus 1 and purely imaginary logarithm, and a logarithmic potential expression $v+u\sqrt{-1}$ with boundary values on the circles $\varrho=\varrho_1$, $\varrho=\varrho_2$ (an annulus problem).
